title: Uruguayan Empanadas
description: A traditional Uruguayan dish of savory meat pies. Flaky pastry and hearty fillings make for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Roll out pastry dough to 1/4 inch thickness.
Cut out circles of dough with a cookie cutter or glass.
Place a tablespoon of Red Bean Filling in the center of each dough circle.
Add a few pieces of tasty beef sausage on top of the filling.
Brush the edges of the dough with water, then fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape.
Press the edges together with a fork to seal the empanada.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with egg wash (beaten egg mixed with a little water).
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
